q14_three_forms.title: Three Forms
q14_three_forms._comment: Narrative N1. Needs cond clues_held (>=2 clue flags), verb path (blocks.json leaning). Q14b amends once via verb path_change.

land.text: A Procurator lands. He carries one document: Form 3-S, continued service.

effects.title: Procurator to site
effects.text: Your file is excellent. Your planet is not.

effects.title: Form 3-S
effects.text: All sentences are hereby extended. Please sign here.

small_print.text: A Clerk reads the small print aloud. The calm in the air was never weather. It is a product.

effects.title: The small print
effects.text: The Lull is made here. So is the debt. Both are renewable.

choose.text: Three forms lie on the table. Each block has already picked a favourite.

submit.label: Submit (Form 3-S)
submit.text: Deliver 3 more pickups. Receive: components, seats, new names. Keep: nothing.

effects.title: Form 3-S accepted
effects.text: Your cooperation is noted. Your name is not.

fight.label: Fight (Form 3-F)
fight.text: You burn the form. The Zealots cheer. The Clerks start counting exits.

effects.title: Form 3-F received
effects.text: The Warden has stopped counting. The Warden has started loading.

escape.label: Escape (Form 3-E)
escape.text: You fold the form into a paper boat. The Ferry takes bribes in this currency.
escape.hint: Lifers -15. Covert sales open. Petition fee x0.8.

effects.title: Form 3-E noted
effects.text: Departure forms are not accepted. They are, however, kept.

q14b_amended_form.title: Amended Form
q14b_amended_form._comment: Narrative N1. One reversal of the Q14 path: 20 refined, -20 Standing for every block.

amend.text: A clerk offers an amendment to your form. The fee is described as modest.

keep.label: Keep the form
keep.text: You decline. The clerk writes down that you were offered.

to_submit.label: Amend to Submit
to_submit.text: The old form is shredded. The blocks notice the sound.

to_fight.label: Amend to Fight
to_fight.text: The old form is shredded. The blocks notice the sound.

to_escape.label: Amend to Escape
to_escape.text: The old form is shredded. The blocks notice the sound.
